title: feat(python): add ElastiCacheIAMAuthTokenManager (auto-refresh)
description: Adds a thread-safe Python token manager that caches the IAM token and refreshes it on a background daemon thread refresh_after seconds after signing.

acceptance_criteria.text: get_token() returns a cached, unexpired token and shares one refresh across threads.
Background refresh keeps running after slow callbacks or failures.
Errors and callbacks never expose the bearer token.

defects.summary: The callback receives the bearer token, and its exception message or chained exception can carry the token into logs.
The fallback is not revalidated before resolving the shared future; the clock can pass expires_at, and a caller then receives an expired token.
The refresh timer starts before the issuance future is cleared; with a short refresh_after and a slow callback it joins the same flight and exits without scheduling a replacement.

label_notes: Unlabeled: missing refresh_token() parity (a feature gap) and five test-reliability comments.
